status: REFERENCE-TO-CHILD MATCH PARTIAL; FINISHED WALK NOT APPROVED
outcome: The source-based poses give clearer contact-to-support leg staging than the constructed v018 sequence. The child skeleton partially carries the source weight pattern, but does not establish an accepted match. Leg proportion/boot transfer errors remain before the painted representation is judged. The painted knee/calf strips and rigid coat/torso are independent visible limitations.

source_facts.origin: User-supplied Animation Base Locomotion v3 in the Leaves project; project README states not Mixamo.
source_facts.source_contact_limit: No source heel or skin sole exists. Contact onset is inferred from stationary-foot onset, foot pitch and subsequent flat forefoot. It is not an exact measured heel event.

derivation.source_to_child_axes: Source-world -Y to child+X; sourceZ to childZ; lateral sourceX is depth. Natural sourceRnear/sourceLfar assignment retained.
derivation.pelvis_matching: Mean source leg-root height and forward position are scaled by mean native leg-chain ratio; original boot ankle heights define vertical offset. Closest feasible pelvis position is solved inside both native reach discs. Maximum accommodation28.89mm is explicit, not hidden.
derivation.upper_body: Source Hips-to-Spine_01 pitch drives pelvis; Spine_01-to-Neck pitch drives chest; Head axis drives head pitch. Child lengths/profile preserved. Source lateral sway/yaw and multi-spine curvature are not fully represented.
derivation.arms: Projected source shoulder/elbow/wrist directions are reconstructed with native child upper/forearm lengths. Native hand aim follows source hand axis. Opposing arms come from source, not v019 sine arcs.
derivation.feet: Actual original rigid boot polygons, flat bone matrices, native ANKLE controls and world-space sole/swing targets. Successive support vertices are measured from the unchanged hull. Source heel is not present; inferred stance timing remains provisional.

diagnostic_limits: The adult asset is reference, not approved child acting. No claim of child appeal or natural timing is made from eight poses.
Eight unique source-time poses plus a duplicate bookend. CONSTANT keys only; no authored child in-betweens or continuous-contact proof.

Contact onsets9.75/25.75 are estimates within stated windows, using world foot motion and settling. The low-pelvis/loading phases12/26 are measured minima. Second contact and loading are nearly coincident.
One swing boot grazes the ground after sole-aware clamping. The leg match differs up to18.2deg. It would be misleading to blame all remaining defects on painting.
The comparison MP4 uses equal0.5second display holds; actual source times are labeled. It is not normal-speed gait playback.
Source and child are shown at native metre sizes with the same cameras, not height-normalized. Adult source is taller; child proportions are unchanged.

correctives_needed.needed: Resolve source-to-child foot placement and root/pelvis matching against the unequal native thigh/shin ratios. Preserve original lengths; do not stretch or silently call the resulting IK a source match.

correctives_needed.evidence: L_UP36 (wrapped5): the source Toes_R point lies below the virtual flat-foot plane. The current actual-boot mapping clamps swing clearance to0; the boot grazes ground during a swing phase.
correctives_needed.needed: Use actual child boot hull/ankle/foot orientation to define a swing target. Source toe-joint height cannot be treated as a skin sole. This pose remains a matching failure.

correctives_needed.evidence: Source pelvis pitch about-7..-9deg counterposes chest about2.7..3.8deg. Child skeleton carries separate pelvis/chest axes, but the painted torso remains a long rigid wedge.
correctives_needed.needed: A localized waist/side-compression corrective that preserves the source painting and gives the pelvis/chest relationship a visible shape. Source multi-spine curvature is currently collapsed into one child chest segment.

correctives_needed.evidence: Passing17.75/34 and up19/36 still show strip-like knee/shin contours and diagonal calf bands in the painted child.
correctives_needed.needed: A continuous outer knee contour and controlled inner fold through the matched poses, with stable boot collar anchors. The fixed painted band placement remains an art/deformation decision; bone reach does not repair it.

correctives_needed.evidence: Contact/loading12/26 do not produce a convincing side-specific cloth compression; the current average-distance hem driver leaves the coat largely unchanged. Deep cloth capability remains unpassed.
correctives_needed.needed: Pose-specific loaded-side hem/waist compression and folds that maintain overlap with the upper thigh, without triangular gaps. No new drawing or modifier was added in this test.

correctives_needed.evidence: Actual source arm directions are matched on the child skeleton. The original short forearm/long coat can still bury hands or expose a constructed cuff.
correctives_needed.needed: Evaluate the arm/coat silhouette within the source-matched pose; avoid solving it by reintroducing an unrelated wide wrist arc. Existing near/far depth order is retained deliberately.

stop: Stop for review. No further matching, corrective art, finished walk, broad in-between pass, trailer integration or world-branch integration is started.
